CRC validation of not ICV secured, extended SYNC and FUP messages If CanTSynUseExtendedMsgFormat is TRUE, CanTSyn shall validate the CRC of Extended SYNC and FUP Messages which are not ICV secured by calculating the CRC over bytes 2 to 15 and the DataID, where byte 2 is applied first, followed by the other bytes in ascending order, and the DataID last.

CRC validation of ICV secured, extended SYNC and FUP messages If CanTSynUseExtendedMsgFormat is TRUE, CanTSyn shall validate the CRC of Extended SYNC and FUP Messages which are ICV secured by calculating the CRC over bytes 2 to 7 and the DataID, where byte 2 is applied first, followed by the other bytes in ascending order, and the DataID last.

CRC generation for not ICV secured, extended SYNC and FUP messages If CanTSynUseExtendedMsgFormat is TRUE, CanTSyn shall generate the CRC of Extended SYNC and FUP Messages which are not ICV secured by calculating the CRC over bytes 2 to 15 and the DataID, where byte 2 is applied first, followed by the other bytes in ascending order, and the DataID last."

CRC generation for ICV secured, extended SYNC and FUP messages If CanTSynUseExtendedMsgFormat is TRUE, CanTSyn shall generate the CRC of Extended SYNC and FUP Messages which are ICV secured by calculating the CRC over bytes 2 to 7 and the DataID, where byte 2 is applied first, followed by the other bytes in ascending order, and the DataID last.
Decrementing of cyclicCounter If cyclicCounter is greater than 0, CanTSyn shall on each call of CanTSyn_MainFunction decrement the cyclicCounter by CanTSynMainFunctionPeriod .
